text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قَدْ أَفْلَحَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ

translations.asad: TRULY, to a happy state shall attain the believers:
translations.sahih: Certainly will the believers have succeeded:

text.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى صَلَاتِهِمْ خَٰشِعُونَ

translations.asad: those who humble themselves in their prayer,
translations.sahih: They who are during their prayer humbly submissive

text.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَنِ ٱللَّغْوِ مُعْرِضُونَ

translations.asad: and who turn away from all that is frivolous,
translations.sahih: And they who turn away from ill speech

text.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِلزَّكَوٰةِ فَٰعِلُونَ

translations.asad: and who are intent on inner purity;
translations.sahih: And they who are observant of zakah

text.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَٰفِظُونَ

translations.asad: and who are mindful of their chastity,
translations.sahih: And they who guard their private parts

text.arabic: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ

translations.asad: [not giving way to their desires] with any but their spouses - that is, those whom they rightfully possess [through wedlock]: for then, behold, they are free of all blame,
translations.sahih: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they will not be blamed -

text.arabic: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ

translations.asad: whereas such as seek to go beyond that [limit] are truly transgressors;
translations.sahih: But whoever seeks beyond that, then those are the transgressors -

text.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَٰنَٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ

translations.asad: and who are faithful to their trusts and to their pledges,
translations.sahih: And they who are to their trusts and their promises attentive

text.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَوَٰتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ

translations.asad: and who guard their prayers [from all worldly intent].
translations.sahih: And they who carefully maintain their prayers -

text.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ

translations.asad: It is they, they who shall be the inheritors
translations.sahih: Those are the inheritors

text.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ ٱلْفِرْدَوْسَ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ

translations.asad: that will inherit the paradise; [and] therein shall they abide.
translations.sahih: Who will inherit al-Firdaus. They will abide therein eternally.

text.arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن سُلَٰلَةٍۢ مِّن طِينٍۢ

translations.asad: NOW, INDEED, We create man out of the essence of clay,
translations.sahih: And certainly did We create man from an extract of clay.

text.arabic: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَٰهُ نُطْفَةًۭ فِى قَرَارٍۢ مَّكِينٍۢ

translations.asad: and then We cause him to remain as a drop of sperm in [the wombs] firm keeping,
translations.sahih: Then We placed him as a sperm-drop in a firm lodging.

text.arabic: ثُمَّ خَلَقْنَا ٱلنُّطْفَةَ عَلَقَةًۭ فَخَلَقْنَا ٱلْعَلَقَةَ مُضْغَةًۭ فَخَلَقْنَا ٱلْمُضْغَةَ عِظَٰمًۭا فَكَسَوْنَا ٱلْعِظَٰمَ لَحْمًۭا ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَٰهُ خَلْقًا ءَاخَرَ ۚ فَتَبَارَكَ ٱللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ ٱلْخَٰلِقِينَ

translations.asad: and then We create out of the drop of sperm a germ-cell, and then We create out of the germ-cell an embryonic lump, and then We create within the embryonic lump bones, and then We clothe the bones with flesh - and then We bring [all] this into being as a new creation: hallowed, therefore, is God, the best of artisans!
translations.sahih: Then We made the sperm-drop into a clinging clot, and We made the clot into a lump [of flesh], and We made [from] the lump, bones, and We covered the bones with flesh; then We developed him into another creation. So blessed is Allah, the best of creators.

text.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُم بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَيِّتُونَ

translations.asad: And then, behold! after all this, you are destined to die;
translations.sahih: Then indeed, after that you are to die.

text.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ تُبْعَثُونَ

translations.asad: and then, behold! you shall be raised from the dead on Resurrection Day.
translations.sahih: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, will be resurrected.

text.arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعَ طَرَآئِقَ وَمَا كُنَّا عَنِ ٱلْخَلْقِ غَٰفِلِينَ

translations.asad: And, indeed, We have created above you seven [celestial] orbits: and never are We unmindful of [any aspect of Our] creation.
translations.sahih: And We have created above you seven layered heavens, and never have We been of [Our] creation unaware.

text.arabic: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍۢ فَأَسْكَنَّٰهُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰ ذَهَابٍۭ بِهِۦ لَقَٰدِرُونَ

translations.asad: And We send down water from the skies in accordance with a measure [set by Us], and then We cause it to lodge in the earth: but, behold, We are most certainly able to withdraw this [blessing]!
translations.sahih: And We have sent down rain from the sky in a measured amount and settled it in the earth. And indeed, We are Able to take it away.

text.arabic: فَأَنشَأْنَا لَكُم بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتٍۢ مِّن نَّخِيلٍۢ وَأَعْنَٰبٍۢ لَّكُمْ فِيهَا فَوَٰكِهُ كَثِيرَةٌۭ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ

translations.asad: And by means of this [water] We bring forth for you gardens of date-palms and vines, wherein you have fruit abundant and whereof you eat,
translations.sahih: And We brought forth for you thereby gardens of palm trees and grapevines in which for you are abundant fruits and from which you eat.

text.arabic: وَشَجَرَةًۭ تَخْرُجُ مِن طُورِ سَيْنَآءَ تَنۢبُتُ بِٱلدُّهْنِ وَصِبْغٍۢ لِّلْءَاكِلِينَ

translations.asad: as well as a tree that issues from [the lands adjoining] Mount Sinai, yielding oil and relish for all to eat.
translations.sahih: And [We brought forth] a tree issuing from Mount Sinai which produces oil and food for those who eat.

text.arabic: وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ لَعِبْرَةًۭ ۖ نُّسْقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِى بُطُونِهَا وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ كَثِيرَةٌۭ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ

translations.asad: And, behold, in the cattle [too] there is indeed a lesson for you: We give you to drink of that [milk] which is within their bellies; and you derive many [other] uses from them: for, you eat of their flesh,
translations.sahih: And indeed, for you in livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from that which is in their bellies, and for you in them are numerous benefits, and from them you eat.

text.arabic: وَعَلَيْهَا وَعَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُونَ

translations.asad: and by them - as by the ships [over the sea] - you are borne [overland].
translations.sahih: And upon them and on ships you are carried.

text.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فَقَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

translations.asad: AND, INDEED, We sent forth Noah unto his people and he said: “O my people! Worship God alone]: you have no deity other than Him. Will you not, then, become conscious of Him?”
translations.sahih: And We had certainly sent Noah to his people, and he said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?"

text.arabic: فَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن قَوْمِهِۦ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُرِيدُ أَن يَتَفَضَّلَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَأَنزَلَ مَلَٰٓئِكَةًۭ مَّا سَمِعْنَا بِهَٰذَا فِىٓ ءَابَآئِنَا ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

translations.asad: But the great ones among his people, who refused to acknowledge the truth, replied: “This [man] is nothing but a mortal like yourselves who wants to make himself superior to you! For, if God had willed [to convey a message unto us], He would surely have sent down angels; [moreover,] we have never heard [any­thing like] this from our forebears of old!
translations.sahih: But the eminent among those who disbelieved from his people said, "This is not but a man like yourselves who wishes to take precedence over you; and if Allah had willed [to send a messenger], He would have sent down angels. We have not heard of this among our forefathers.

text.arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌۢ بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌۭ فَتَرَبَّصُوا۟ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ

translations.asad: He is nothing but a madman: so bear with him for a while.”
translations.sahih: He is not but a man possessed with madness, so wait concerning him for a time."

text.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ

translations.asad: Said [Noah]: “O my Sustainer! Succour me against their accusation of lying!”
translations.sahih: [Noah] said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."

text.arabic: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ أَنِ ٱصْنَعِ ٱلْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَا فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ ٱلتَّنُّورُ ۙ فَٱسْلُكْ فِيهَا مِن كُلٍّۢ زَوْجَيْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا مَن سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقَوْلُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَلَا تُخَٰطِبْنِى فِى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ ۖ إِنَّهُم مُّغْرَقُونَ

translations.asad: Thereupon We inspired him thus: “Build, un­der Our eyes and according to Our inspiration, the ark [that shall save thee and those who follow thee]. And when Our judgment comes to pass, and waters gush forth in torrents over the face of the earth, place on board of this [ark] one pair of each [kind of animal] of either sex, as well as thy family - excepting those on whom sentence has already been passed; and do not appeal to Me [any more] in behalf of those who are bent on evildoing - for, behold, they are destined to be drowned!
translations.sahih: So We inspired to him, "Construct the ship under Our observation, and Our inspiration, and when Our command comes and the oven overflows, put into the ship from each [creature] two mates and your family, except those for whom the decree [of destruction] has proceeded. And do not address Me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are to be drowned.

text.arabic: فَإِذَا ٱسْتَوَيْتَ أَنتَ وَمَن مَّعَكَ عَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ فَقُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى نَجَّىٰنَا مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

translations.asad: “And as soon as thou and those who are with thee are settled in the ark, say: ‘All praise is due to God, who has saved us from those evildoing folk!’
translations.sahih: And when you have boarded the ship, you and those with you, then say, 'Praise to Allah who has saved us from the wrongdoing people.'

text.arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَنزِلْنِى مُنزَلًۭا مُّبَارَكًۭا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْمُنزِلِينَ

translations.asad: “And say: ‘O my Sustainer! Cause me to reach a destination blessed [by Thee] for Thou art the best to show man how to reach his [true] destination!’”
translations.sahih: And say, 'My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate [us].' "

text.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ وَإِن كُنَّا لَمُبْتَلِينَ

translations.asad: In this [story], behold, there are messages indeed [for those who think]: for, verily, We always put [man] to a test.
translations.sahih: Indeed in that are signs, and indeed, We are ever testing [Our servants].

text.arabic: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا ءَاخَرِينَ

translations.asad: AND AFTER those [people of old] We gave rise to new generations;
translations.sahih: Then We produced after them a generation of others.

text.arabic: فَأَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِمْ رَسُولًۭا مِّنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

translations.asad: and [every time] We sent unto them an apostle from among themselves, [he told them:] “Worship God [alone]: you have no deity other than Him. Will you not, then, become conscious of Him?”
translations.sahih: And We sent among them a messenger from themselves, [saying], "Worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?"

text.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِن قَوْمِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِلِقَآءِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَأَتْرَفْنَٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُكُمْ يَأْكُلُ مِمَّا تَأْكُلُونَ مِنْهُ وَيَشْرَبُ مِمَّا تَشْرَبُونَ

translations.asad: And [every time] the great ones among his people, who refused to acknowledge the truth and gave the lie to the announcement of a life to come - [simply] because We had granted them ease and plenty in [their] worldly life, and they had become corrupted by it [every time] they would say: “This [man] is nothing hut a mortal like yourselves, eating of what you eat, and drinking of what you drink:
translations.sahih: And the eminent among his people who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter while We had given them luxury in the worldly life said, "This is not but a man like yourselves. He eats of that from which you eat and drinks of what you drink.

text.arabic: وَلَئِنْ أَطَعْتُم بَشَرًۭا مِّثْلَكُمْ إِنَّكُمْ إِذًۭا لَّخَٰسِرُونَ

translations.asad: and, indeed, if you pay heed to a mortal like your­selves, you will surely be the losers!
translations.sahih: And if you should obey a man like yourselves, indeed, you would then be losers.

text.arabic: أَيَعِدُكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ إِذَا مِتُّمْ وَكُنتُمْ تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَنَّكُم مُّخْرَجُونَ

translations.asad: Does he promise you that, after you have died and become [mere] dust and bones, you shall be brought forth [to a new life]?
translations.sahih: Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones that you will be brought forth [once more]?

text.arabic: ۞ هَيْهَاتَ هَيْهَاتَ لِمَا تُوعَدُونَ

translations.asad: Far-fetched, far-fetched indeed is what you are promised!
translations.sahih: How far, how far, is that which you are promised.

text.arabic: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوثِينَ

translations.asad: There is no life beyond our life in this world: we die and we live [but once], and we shall never be raised from the dead!
translations.sahih: Life is not but our worldly life - we die and live, but we will not be resurrected.

text.arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا وَمَا نَحْنُ لَهُۥ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ

translations.asad: He is nothing but a man who attributes his own lying in­ventions to God, and we are not going to believe him!”
translations.sahih: He is not but a man who has invented a lie about Allah, and we will not believe him."

text.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ

translations.asad: [Whereupon the prophet] would say: “O my Sustainer! Succour me against their accusation of lying!”
translations.sahih: He said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."

text.arabic: قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِيلٍۢ لَّيُصْبِحُنَّ نَٰدِمِينَ

translations.asad: [And God] would say: “After a little while they will surely be smitten with remorse!”
translations.sahih: [Allah] said, "After a little, they will surely become regretful."

text.arabic: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ غُثَآءًۭ ۚ فَبُعْدًۭا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

translations.asad: And then the blast [of Our punishment] over­took them, justly and unavoidably, and We caused them to become as the flotsam of dead leaves and the scum borne on the surface of a torrent: and so - away with those evildoing folk!
translations.sahih: So the shriek seized them in truth, and We made them as [plant] stubble. Then away with the wrongdoing people.

text.arabic: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قُرُونًا ءَاخَرِينَ

translations.asad: AND AFTER them We gave rise to new genera­tions:
translations.sahih: Then We produced after them other generations.

text.arabic: مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ

translations.asad: [for,] no community can ever forestall [the end of] its term - and neither can they delay [its coming].
translations.sahih: No nation will precede its time [of termination], nor will they remain [thereafter].

text.arabic: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتْرَا ۖ كُلَّ مَا جَآءَ أُمَّةًۭ رَّسُولُهَا كَذَّبُوهُ ۚ فَأَتْبَعْنَا بَعْضَهُم بَعْضًۭا وَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ ۚ فَبُعْدًۭا لِّقَوْمٍۢ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ

translations.asad: And We sent forth Our apostles, one after another: [and] every time their apostle came to a community, they gave him the lie: and so We caused them to follow one another [into the grave], and let them become [mere] tales: and so - away with the folk who would not believe!
translations.sahih: Then We sent Our messengers in succession. Every time there came to a nation its messenger, they denied him, so We made them follow one another [to destruction], and We made them narrations. So away with a people who do not believe.

text.arabic: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَأَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍ

translations.asad: AND THEN We sent forth Moses and his brother Aaron with Our messages and a manifest authority [from Us]
translations.sahih: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and a clear authority

text.arabic: إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا عَالِينَ

translations.asad: unto Pharaoh and his great ones; but these behaved with arrogance, for they were people wont to glorify [only] themselves.
translations.sahih: To Pharaoh and his establishment, but they were arrogant and were a haughty people.

text.arabic: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ لِبَشَرَيْنِ مِثْلِنَا وَقَوْمُهُمَا لَنَا عَٰبِدُونَ

translations.asad: And so they said: “Shall we believe [them] two mortals like ourselves - although their people are our slaves?”
translations.sahih: They said, "Should we believe two men like ourselves while their people are for us in servitude?"

text.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَكَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُهْلَكِينَ

translations.asad: Thus, they gave the lie to those two, and earned (thereby) their place among the doomed:
translations.sahih: So they denied them and were of those destroyed.

text.arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَٰبَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ

translations.asad: for, indeed, We had vouchsafed revelation unto Moses in order that they might find the right way.
translations.sahih: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture that perhaps they would be guided.

text.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُۥٓ ءَايَةًۭ وَءَاوَيْنَٰهُمَآ إِلَىٰ رَبْوَةٍۢ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍۢ وَمَعِينٍۢ

translations.asad: And [as We exalted Moses, so, too,] We made the son of Mary and his mother a symbol [of Our grace], and provided for both an abode in a lofty place of lasting restfulness and unsullied springs.
translations.sahih: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water.

text.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلرُّسُلُ كُلُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَٰلِحًا ۖ إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌۭ

translations.asad: O YOU APOSTLES! Partake of the good things of life, and do righteous deeds: verily, I have full knowledge of all that you do.
translations.sahih: [Allah said], "O messengers, eat from the good foods and work righteousness. Indeed, I, of what you do, am Knowing.

text.arabic: وَإِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمْ فَٱتَّقُونِ

translations.asad: And, verily, this community of yours is one single community, since I am the Sustainer of you all: remain, then, conscious of Me!
translations.sahih: And indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so fear Me."

text.arabic: فَتَقَطَّعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ زُبُرًۭا ۖ كُلُّ حِزْبٍۭ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ

translations.asad: But they (who claim to follow you) have torn their unity wide asunder, piece by piece, each group delighting in [but] what they themselves possess [by way of tenets].
translations.sahih: But the people divided their religion among them into sects - each faction, in what it has, rejoicing.

text.arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ فِى غَمْرَتِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ

translations.asad: But leave them alone, lost in their ignorance, until a [future] time.
translations.sahih: So leave them in their confusion for a time.

text.arabic: أَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُم بِهِۦ مِن مَّالٍۢ وَبَنِينَ

translations.asad: Do they think that by all the wealth and offspring with which We provide them
translations.sahih: Do they think that what We extend to them of wealth and children

text.arabic: نُسَارِعُ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ ۚ بَل لَّا يَشْعُرُونَ

translations.asad: We [but want to] make them vie with one another in doing [what they consider] good works? Nay, but they do not perceive [their error]!
translations.sahih: Is [because] We hasten for them good things? Rather, they do not perceive.

text.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ

translations.asad: Verily, [only] they who stand in reverent awe of their Sustainer,
translations.sahih: Indeed, they who are apprehensive from fear of their Lord

text.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ

translations.asad: and who believe in their Sus­tainer’s messages,
translations.sahih: And they who believe in the signs of their Lord

text.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِرَبِّهِمْ لَا يُشْرِكُونَ

translations.asad: and who do not ascribe divinity to aught but their Sustainer,
translations.sahih: And they who do not associate anything with their Lord

text.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْتُونَ مَآ ءَاتَوا۟ وَّقُلُوبُهُمْ وَجِلَةٌ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ رَٰجِعُونَ

translations.asad: and who give whatever they [have to] give with their hearts trembling at the thought that unto their Sustainer they must return:
translations.sahih: And they who give what they give while their hearts are fearful because they will be returning to their Lord -

text.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُسَٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَهُمْ لَهَا سَٰبِقُونَ

translations.asad: it is they who vie with one another in doing good works, and it is they who outrun [all others] in attaining to them!
translations.sahih: It is those who hasten to good deeds, and they outstrip [others] therein.

text.arabic: وَلَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۖ وَلَدَيْنَا كِتَٰبٌۭ يَنطِقُ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ

translations.asad: And [withal.] We do not burden any human being with more than he is well able to bear: for with Us is a record that speaks the truth [about what men do and can do]; and none shall be wronged.
translations.sahih: And We charge no soul except [with that within] its capacity, and with Us is a record which speaks with truth; and they will not be wronged.

text.arabic: بَلْ قُلُوبُهُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍۢ مِّنْ هَٰذَا وَلَهُمْ أَعْمَٰلٌۭ مِّن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ هُمْ لَهَا عَٰمِلُونَ

translations.asad: NAY, [as for those who have torn asunder the unity of faith] - their hearts are lost in ignorance of all this! But apart from that [breach of unity] they have [on their conscience even worse] deeds; and they will [continue to] commit them
translations.sahih: But their hearts are covered with confusion over this, and they have [evil] deeds besides disbelief which they are doing,

text.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَخَذْنَا مُتْرَفِيهِم بِٱلْعَذَابِ إِذَا هُمْ يَجْـَٔرُونَ

translations.asad: until - after We shall have taken to task, through suffering, those from among them who [now] are lost in the pursuit of pleasures - they cry out in [belated] supplication.
translations.sahih: Until when We seize their affluent ones with punishment, at once they are crying [to Allah] for help.

text.arabic: لَا تَجْـَٔرُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ۖ إِنَّكُم مِّنَّا لَا تُنصَرُونَ

translations.asad: [But they will be told:] “Cry not in supplication today: for, behold, you shall not he succoured by Us!
translations.sahih: Do not cry out today. Indeed, by Us you will not be helped.

text.arabic: قَدْ كَانَتْ ءَايَٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْقَٰبِكُمْ تَنكِصُونَ

translations.asad: Time and again were My messages conveyed unto you, but [every time] you would turn about on your heels
translations.sahih: My verses had already been recited to you, but you were turning back on your heels

text.arabic: مُسْتَكْبِرِينَ بِهِۦ سَٰمِرًۭا تَهْجُرُونَ

translations.asad: [and,] impelled by your arrogance, you would talk senselessly far into the night.”
translations.sahih: In arrogance regarding it, conversing by night, speaking evil.

text.arabic: أَفَلَمْ يَدَّبَّرُوا۟ ٱلْقَوْلَ أَمْ جَآءَهُم مَّا لَمْ يَأْتِ ءَابَآءَهُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

translations.asad: Have they, then, never tried to understand this word [of God]? Or has there [now] come to them something that never came to their forefathers of old?
translations.sahih: Then have they not reflected over the Qur'an, or has there come to them that which had not come to their forefathers?

text.arabic: أَمْ لَمْ يَعْرِفُوا۟ رَسُولَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ

translations.asad: Or is it, perchance, that they have not recog­nized their Apostle, and so they disavow him?
translations.sahih: Or did they not know their Messenger, so they are toward him disacknowledging?

text.arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌۢ ۚ بَلْ جَآءَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَٰرِهُونَ

translations.asad: Or do they say. “There is madness in him”? Nay, he has brought them the truth - and the truth do most of them detest!
translations.sahih: Or do they say, "In him is madness?" Rather, he brought them the truth, but most of them, to the truth, are averse.

text.arabic: وَلَوِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ لَفَسَدَتِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّ ۚ بَلْ أَتَيْنَٰهُم بِذِكْرِهِمْ فَهُمْ عَن ذِكْرِهِم مُّعْرِضُونَ

translations.asad: But if the truth were in accord with their own likes and dislikes, the heavens and the earth would surely have fallen into ruin, and all that lives in them [would long ago have perished]! Nay, [in this divine writ] We have conveyed unto them all that they ought to bear in mind: and from this their reminder they [heedlessly] turn away!
translations.sahih: But if the Truth had followed their inclinations, the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them would have been ruined. Rather, We have brought them their message, but they, from their message, are turning away.

text.arabic: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ خَرْجًۭا فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌۭ ۖ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ

translations.asad: Or dost thou [O Muhammad] ask of them any worldly recompense? But [they ought to know that] recompense from thy Sustainer is best, since He is the best of providers!
translations.sahih: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask them for payment? But the reward of your Lord is best, and He is the best of providers.

text.arabic: وَإِنَّكَ لَتَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ

translations.asad: And, verily, thou callest them onto a straight way –
translations.sahih: And indeed, you invite them to a straight path.

text.arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ عَنِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ لَنَٰكِبُونَ

translations.asad: but, behold, those who will not believe in the life to come are bound to deviate from that way.
translations.sahih: But indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter are deviating from the path.

text.arabic: ۞ وَلَوْ رَحِمْنَٰهُمْ وَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِم مِّن ضُرٍّۢ لَّلَجُّوا۟ فِى طُغْيَٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ

translations.asad: And even were We to show them mercy and remove whatever distress might befall them [in this life], they would still persist in their overweening arrogance, blindly stumbling to and fro.
translations.sahih: And even if We gave them mercy and removed what was upon them of affliction, they would persist in their transgression, wandering blindly.

text.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَٰهُم بِٱلْعَذَابِ فَمَا ٱسْتَكَانُوا۟ لِرَبِّهِمْ وَمَا يَتَضَرَّعُونَ

translations.asad: And, indeed, We tested them through suffer­ing, but they did not abase themselves before their Sustainer; and they will never humble them­selves
translations.sahih: And We had gripped them with suffering [as a warning], but they did not yield to their Lord, nor did they humbly supplicate, [and will continue thus]

text.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًۭا ذَا عَذَابٍۢ شَدِيدٍ إِذَا هُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ

translations.asad: until We open before them a gate of [truly] severe suffering [in the life to come]: and then, lo! they will be broken in spirit.
translations.sahih: Until when We have opened before them a door of severe punishment, immediately they will be therein in despair.

text.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ

translations.asad: [O MEN! Pay heed to God’s messages,] for it is He who has endowed you with hearing, and sight, and minds: [yet] how seldom are you grateful!
translations.sahih: And it is He who produced for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful.

text.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ

translations.asad: And He it is who has caused you to multiply on earth; and unto Him you shall be gathered.
translations.sahih: And it is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered.

text.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ وَلَهُ ٱخْتِلَٰفُ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ ۚ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ

translations.asad: And He it is who grants life and deals death; and to Him is due the alternation of night and day. Will you not, then, use your reason?
translations.sahih: And it is He who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of the night and the day. Then will you not reason?

text.arabic: بَلْ قَالُوا۟ مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ

translations.asad: But nay, they speak as the people of olden times did speak:
translations.sahih: Rather, they say like what the former peoples said.

text.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ

translations.asad: they say: “What! After we have died and become mere dust and bones, shall we, forsooth, be raised from the dead?
translations.sahih: They said, "When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?

text.arabic: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا نَحْنُ وَءَابَآؤُنَا هَٰذَا مِن قَبْلُ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

translations.asad: Indeed, this [very thing] we have been promised - we and our forefathers - long ago! This is nothing but fables of ancient times!”
translations.sahih: We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before; this is not but legends of the former peoples."

text.arabic: قُل لِّمَنِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهَآ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

translations.asad: Say: “Unto whom belongs the earth and all that lives there on? [Tell me this] if you happen to know [the answer]!”
translations.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "To whom belongs the earth and whoever is in it, if you should know?"

text.arabic: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ

translations.asad: [And they will reply: “Unto God.” Say: “Will you not, then, bethink yourselves [of Him]?”
translations.sahih: They will say, "To Allah." Say, "Then will you not remember?"

text.arabic: قُلْ مَن رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلسَّبْعِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

translations.asad: Say: “Who is it that sustains the seven heavens and is enthroned in His awesome almightiness?”
translations.sahih: Say, "Who is Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Great Throne?"

text.arabic: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

translations.asad: [And] they will reply: “[All this power belongs] to God.” Say: “Will you not, then, remain conscious of Him?”
translations.sahih: They will say, "[They belong] to Allah." Say, "Then will you not fear Him?"

text.arabic: قُلْ مَنۢ بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَهُوَ يُجِيرُ وَلَا يُجَارُ عَلَيْهِ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

translations.asad: Say: “In whose hand rests the mighty dominion over all things, and who is it that protects, the while there is no protection against Him? [Tell me this] if you happen to know [the answer]!”
translations.sahih: Say, "In whose hand is the realm of all things - and He protects while none can protect against Him - if you should know?"

text.arabic: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ فَأَنَّىٰ تُسْحَرُونَ

translations.asad: [And] they will reply: “[All this power belongs] to God.” Say: ‘How, then, can you be so deluded?”
translations.sahih: They will say, "[All belongs] to Allah." Say, "Then how are you deluded?"

text.arabic: بَلْ أَتَيْنَٰهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَٰذِبُونَ

translations.asad: Nay, We have conveyed unto them the truth: and yet, behold, they are intent on lying [to them­selves]!
translations.sahih: Rather, We have brought them the truth, and indeed they are liars.

text.arabic: مَا ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ مِن وَلَدٍۢ وَمَا كَانَ مَعَهُۥ مِنْ إِلَٰهٍ ۚ إِذًۭا لَّذَهَبَ كُلُّ إِلَٰهٍۭ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَلَعَلَا بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

translations.asad: Never did God take unto Himself any offspring, nor has there ever been any deity side by side with Him: [for, had there been any,] lo! each deity would surely have stood apart [from the others] in whatever it had created, and they would surely have [tried to] overcome one another! Limitless in His glory is God, [far] above anything that men may devise by way of definition,
translations.sahih: Allah has not taken any son, nor has there ever been with Him any deity. [If there had been], then each deity would have taken what it created, and some of them would have sought to overcome others. Exalted is Allah above what they describe [concerning Him].

text.arabic: عَٰلِمِ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ فَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

translations.asad: knowing all that is beyond the reach of a created being’s perception as well as all that can be witnessed by a creature’s senses or mind and, hence, sublimely exalted is He above anything to which they may ascribe a share in His divinity!
translations.sahih: [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, so high is He above what they associate [with Him].

text.arabic: قُل رَّبِّ إِمَّا تُرِيَنِّى مَا يُوعَدُونَ

translations.asad: SAY: “O my Sustainer! If it be Thy will to let me witness [the fulfillment of] whatever they [who blaspheme against Thee] have been promised [to suffer] –
translations.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "My Lord, if You should show me that which they are promised,

text.arabic: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجْعَلْنِى فِى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

translations.asad: do not, O my Sustainer, let me be one of those evildoing folk!”
translations.sahih: My Lord, then do not place me among the wrongdoing people."

text.arabic: وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّرِيَكَ مَا نَعِدُهُمْ لَقَٰدِرُونَ

translations.asad: [Pray thus] for, behold, We are most cer­tainly able to let thee witness [the fulfillment, even in this world, of] whatever We promise them!
translations.sahih: And indeed, We are able to show you what We have promised them.

text.arabic: ٱدْفَعْ بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ ٱلسَّيِّئَةَ ۚ نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَصِفُونَ

translations.asad: [But whatever they may say or do,] repel the evil [which they commit] with something that is bet­ter: We are fully aware of what they attribute [to Us].
translations.sahih: Repel, by [means of] what is best, [their] evil. We are most knowing of what they describe.

text.arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَٰتِ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ

translations.asad: And say: “O my Sustainer! I seek refuge with Thee from the promptings of all evil impulses;
translations.sahih: And say, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils,

text.arabic: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحْضُرُونِ

translations.asad: and I seek refuge with Thee, O my Sustainer, lest they come near unto me!’
translations.sahih: And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me."

text.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَ أَحَدَهُمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ قَالَ رَبِّ ٱرْجِعُونِ

translations.asad: [AS FOR THOSE who will not believe in the life to come, they go on lying to themselves] until, when death approaches any of them, he prays: “O my Sustainer! Let me return, let me return [to life],
translations.sahih: [For such is the state of the disbelievers], until, when death comes to one of them, he says, "My Lord, send me back

text.arabic: لَعَلِّىٓ أَعْمَلُ صَٰلِحًۭا فِيمَا تَرَكْتُ ۚ كَلَّآ ۚ إِنَّهَا كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قَآئِلُهَا ۖ وَمِن وَرَآئِهِم بَرْزَخٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ

translations.asad: so that I might act righteously in whatever I have failed [aforetime]!” Nay, it is indeed but a [meaningless] word that he utters: for behind those [who leave the world] there is a barrier [of death] until the Day when all will be raised from the dead!
translations.sahih: That I might do righteousness in that which I left behind." No! It is only a word he is saying; and behind them is a barrier until the Day they are resurrected.

text.arabic: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَلَآ أَنسَابَ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَلَا يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

translations.asad: Then, when the trumpet [of resurrection] is blown, no ties of kinship will on that Day prevail among them, and neither will they ask about one another.
translations.sahih: So when the Horn is blown, no relationship will there be among them that Day, nor will they ask about one another.

text.arabic: فَمَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ

translations.asad: And they whose weight [of righteousness] is heavy in the balance - it is they, they who will have attained to a happy state;
translations.sahih: And those whose scales are heavy [with good deeds] - it is they who are the successful.

text.arabic: وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فِى جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدُونَ

translations.asad: whereas they whose weight is light in the balance - it is they who will have squandered their own selves, [destined] to abide in hell:
translations.sahih: But those whose scales are light - those are the ones who have lost their souls, [being] in Hell, abiding eternally.

text.arabic: تَلْفَحُ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَهُمْ فِيهَا كَٰلِحُونَ

translations.asad: the fire will scorch their faces, and they will abide therein with their lips distorted in pain.
translations.sahih: The Fire will sear their faces, and they therein will have taut smiles.

text.arabic: أَلَمْ تَكُنْ ءَايَٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ

translations.asad: [And God will say:] “Were not My messages conveyed unto you, and were you [not] wont to give them the lie?”
translations.sahih: [It will be said]. "Were not My verses recited to you and you used to deny them?"

text.arabic: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتْ عَلَيْنَا شِقْوَتُنَا وَكُنَّا قَوْمًۭا ضَآلِّينَ

translations.asad: They will exclaim: “O our Sustainer! Our bad luck has overwhelmed us, and so we went astray!
translations.sahih: They will say, "Our Lord, our wretchedness overcame us, and we were a people astray.

text.arabic: رَبَّنَآ أَخْرِجْنَا مِنْهَا فَإِنْ عُدْنَا فَإِنَّا ظَٰلِمُونَ

translations.asad: O our Sustainer! Cause us to come out of this [suffering] - and then, if ever We revert [to sinning], may we truly be [deemed] evildoers!”
translations.sahih: Our Lord, remove us from it, and if we were to return [to evil], we would indeed be wrongdoers."

text.arabic: قَالَ ٱخْسَـُٔوا۟ فِيهَا وَلَا تُكَلِّمُونِ

translations.asad: [But] He will say: “Away with you into this [ignominy]! And speak no more unto Me!
translations.sahih: He will say, "Remain despised therein and do not speak to Me.

text.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فَرِيقٌۭ مِّنْ عِبَادِى يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ

translations.asad: “Behold, there were among My servants such as would pray, ‘O our Sustainer! We have come to believe [in Thee]; forgive, then, our sins and bestow Thy mercy on us: for Thou art the truest bestower of mercy!’
translations.sahih: Indeed, there was a party of My servants who said, 'Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.'

text.arabic: فَٱتَّخَذْتُمُوهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا حَتَّىٰٓ أَنسَوْكُمْ ذِكْرِى وَكُنتُم مِّنْهُمْ تَضْحَكُونَ

translations.asad: - but you made them a target of your derision to the point where it made you forget all remembrance of Me; and you went on and on laugh­ing at them.
translations.sahih: But you took them in mockery to the point that they made you forget My remembrance, and you used to laugh at them.

text.arabic: إِنِّى جَزَيْتُهُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا صَبَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ هُمُ ٱلْفَآئِزُونَ

translations.asad: [But,] behold, today I have rewarded them for their patience in adversity: verily, it is they, they who have achieved a triumph!”
translations.sahih: Indeed, I have rewarded them this Day for their patient endurance - that they are the attainers [of success]."

text.arabic: قَٰلَ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ عَدَدَ سِنِينَ

translations.asad: [And] He will ask [the doomed]: “What number of years have you spent on earth?”
translations.sahih: [Allah] will say, "How long did you remain on earth in number of years?"

text.arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَبِثْنَا يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍۢ فَسْـَٔلِ ٱلْعَآدِّينَ

translations.asad: They will answer: ‘We have spent there a day, or part of a day; but ask those who [are able to] count [time] …”
translations.sahih: They will say, "We remained a day or part of a day; ask those who enumerate."

text.arabic: قَٰلَ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا ۖ لَّوْ أَنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

translations.asad: [Whereupon] He will say: “You have spent there but a short while: had you but known [how short it was to be]!
translations.sahih: He will say, "You stayed not but a little - if only you had known.

text.arabic: أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ عَبَثًۭا وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَ

translations.asad: Did you, then, think that We created you in mere idle play, and that you would not have to return to Us?”
translations.sahih: Then did you think that We created you uselessly and that to Us you would not be returned?"

text.arabic: فَتَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْكَرِيمِ

translations.asad: [KNOW,] then, [that] God is sublimely exalted, the Ultimate Sovereign, the Ultimate Truth: there is no deity save Him, the Sustainer, in bountiful almightiness enthroned!
translations.sahih: So exalted is Allah, the Sovereign, the Truth; there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Noble Throne.

text.arabic: وَمَن يَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ لَا بُرْهَٰنَ لَهُۥ بِهِۦ فَإِنَّمَا حِسَابُهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ

translations.asad: Hence, he who invokes, side by side with God, any other deity [- a deity] for whose existence he has no evidence - shall but find his reckoning with his Sustainer: [and,] verily, such deniers of the truth will never attain to a happy state!
translations.sahih: And whoever invokes besides Allah another deity for which he has no proof - then his account is only with his Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will not succeed.

text.arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ وَٱرْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ

translations.asad: Hence, [O believer,] say: “O my Sustainer! Grant [me] forgiveness and bestow Thy mercy [upon me]: for Thou art the truest bestower of mercy!”
translations.sahih: And, [O Muhammad], say, "My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful."
